summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The FT Vest SPCX & Target Income ETF (XVSP) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in income alternatives. The fund is an actively managed ETF seeking monthly income of approximately 15%, before fees and expenses, above the S&P 500 forward dividend yield, through a multi-layered options strategy built around Space Exploration Technologies Corp. stock, while maintaining partial participation in SPCXs price appreciation. XVSP was launched on Aug 25, 2026 and is issued by First Trust.
